response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and infrastructure, and recent exposure to MCP and agentic workflow tooling, but his resume shows no substantive track record in GenAI-specific systems, RAG architectures, vector databases, or AI evaluation/observability pipelines, which are core to this role. The 8+ years of AI-driven solution experience required is not demonstrated; his AI-agent work appears to be only a few months old.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, deep software engineering experience across multiple stacks and domains
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic workflow tooling
Strong technical leadership, mentoring, and craftsmanship track record (TDD, CI/CD, workshops, talks)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with vector databases or RAG architectures
No evidence of building production AI/ML data pipelines for structured or unstructured data
AI/GenAI-specific experience is very recent (since April 2025) and not close to the required 8+ years

key_factors.factor: Insufficient depth/duration of GenAI-specific work experience
Strong general staff-level engineering and leadership background
